subject: Subscripts
notes: PB1016 LANDED 2026-09-22: the DATA DIVISION reference - CONSTANT AS LENGTH OF data-name-2 (SS13.10) - now reaches the same ReferenceResolver.ScreenSubscriptArity every procedure-division reference takes; before, `01 KL CONSTANT AS LENGTH OF PLAIN(1).` over a non-table item compiled and KL was 7. The constant binder's private suffix walk is gone (ReadWritten), so a subscript hung off a qualification is screened too. SR2 has two halves - 'shall contain an OCCURS clause OR SHALL BE SUBORDINATE TO a data description entry that contains an OCCURS clause' - and the compiler wrote down only the first, as DataItem.IsTable. Both halves are now one predicate, DataItem.IsTableElement (= SubscriptArity > 0), read by the ONE declaration-informed '(' rule the three subscript-splitting callers share. POSITIVE: the 85 golden subscripts X, which carries no OCCURS clause of its own and is subordinate to one, in every reference position - a receiving operand of MOVE / ADD / COMPUTE / STRING / UNSTRING / INITIALIZE, a sending operand, a relative subscript, a reference-modification leftmost position, an intrinsic-function argument and a SEARCH ALL identifier-1. NEGATIVE: a subscript on an item satisfying NEITHER half is COBOL2096 at all four editions. Before kb/Work PB877 that violation drew COBOL0899 'not yet implemented' on the receiving side - a promise about permanently illegal source - and compiled clean and aborted at run time on the sending side, where 4.2.2 requires a compile-time mechanism.
